implementation_statement: Suite accounts are named; the MSP creates and disables them on the Office and Compliance Administrator's request. On the OT side the HMI has one shared "operator" sign-in and the remote desktop tool one shared password used by 5 staff and 2 integrator engineers. There is no termination checklist: a former operator-mechanic (left 2024-11-15) knew the remote password until it was changed on 2026-08-12. Planned: termination checklist by 2026-09-30; named HMI and remote access accounts with the remote access rebuild (2026-11-30) and HMI replacement (2027-03-31).
evidence: Suite user export; HMI user list; remote desktop tool account settings
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.2; Table 9.3a access control, voluntary benchmark)

implementation_statement: The HMI has operator and engineer roles, but everyone signs in as operator, which can move gates and units. Suite folders have permissions, but the folder with drawings, EAP inundation maps, and the control network drawing is open to all 7 staff and shared with the integrator and consulting engineer by "anyone with the link". Planned: restricted CEII folder with named external guests by 2026-09-30.
evidence: Suite sharing report; HMI role settings

implementation_statement: Office users are not local administrators (MSP policy). The shared HMI operator account has full gate and unit control, and remote desktop sessions run with Windows administrator rights on the HMI PC. Planned: separate view-only, operator, and engineer accounts with the HMI replacement.
evidence: MSP endpoint policy; HMI PC local administrators list
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3b access control: least privilege, voluntary)

provider_if_inherited: Productivity suite vendor; remote desktop tool vendor
implementation_statement: The suite and the remote desktop tool block repeated failed sign-ins using vendor defaults (settings confirmed 2026-07-21). The HMI application has no lockout configured.
evidence: Suite and remote desktop tool security settings

provider_if_inherited: Remote desktop tool vendor; controls integrator
implementation_statement: Two remote paths reach the control system: the remote desktop tool on the HMI PC (unattended access, one shared password, no MFA, full control of gates and units) and the integrator's always-on cellular VPN to the control network. Neither was authorized in writing. Interim: password changed 2026-08-12 and given only to the 5 staff; from 2026-09-15 the integrator router is powered on only for sessions a staff member starts and watches. Planned: one remote access path with MFA, named accounts, and view-only by default, by 2026-11-30.
evidence: Remote desktop tool configuration; integrator router description; on-call rota
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.3.3; Table 9.3a access control: remote and third-party connections, voluntary); C-DAMS-R02 (18 CFR 12.10 if misused)

implementation_statement: Office Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a separate guest network (MSP). The integrator's cellular router and the monitoring service's cellular data gateway were added to the control network without any risk evaluation; the gateway web page still had its manufacturer default password (P07). Planned: risk evaluation and private cellular addressing with the remote access rebuild.

Only one MSP phishing email campaign for the 3 office users in 2025. Planned: annual 1-hour session for all 7 staff on physical and cyber security, CEII handling, remote access rules, and what to report, first held by 2026-10-31.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.2 annual training; Table 9.3a training, voluntary)

implementation_statement: No control system security training for the Controls and Electrical Technician or operator-mechanics. Planned: an introductory industrial control system security course for the Controls and Electrical Technician and a briefing for operator-mechanics on remote access and unusual HMI behavior, by 2026-12-31.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a training: advanced training for significant roles, voluntary)

provider_if_inherited: Remote desktop tool vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: The HMI records alarms and operator commands, but only under the shared account. The remote desktop tool vendor keeps a 30-day connection log. The suite logs sign-ins. Firewall logging is off and the integrator VPN leaves no record at the company.
evidence: HMI event journal sample; remote desktop connection log export
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a intrusion detection and response, voluntary)

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Nobody reviews any log. Planned: a weekly 15-minute check of remote sessions against the on-call rota and integrator work orders, recorded on a checklist, from 2026-09.
The HMI event journal keeps about 180 days. The remote desktop log is kept only 30 days by the vendor. Planned: monthly export of the remote session log into the suite, kept 1 year.
evidence: HMI journal settings; vendor log retention statement
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a intrusion detection, voluntary); C-DAMS-R02 (18 CFR 12.10(a)(2) written reports need records)

implementation_statement: An independent OT security consultant assessed 13 controls from 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 (P07). POL-02 A.6 requires an assessment every year.

No written terms cover the integrator's VPN, the monitoring service's data gateway, or the camera vendor relay. Planned: connection and security terms added to the integrator and monitoring contracts at renewal, by 2027-03-31.
evidence: Integrator service agreement; monitoring subscription terms
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a general: review network connections, voluntary)

implementation_statement: No documented baseline. Only the integrator's 2015 network drawing exists. Planned: record versions and settings for the HMI PC, PLCs, firewall, router, and gateway with the inventory (CM-8).

Gate and unit setpoint changes are approved by the Plant Superintendent and written in the operations log. Changes to the computers were not: the remote desktop tool (2021), the cellular gateway, and the AI add-on (2026-05-04) were added with no security review. Planned: a one-page change form with a security question for any change to SYS-01 to SYS-07.
Staff browse weather radar websites on the HMI PC. Planned: block web browsing on the HMI PC and show weather on an office PC instead, by 2026-10-31.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control: approved control system activities only, voluntary)

implementation_statement: No OT inventory. The MSP lists the 6 office endpoints only. Planned: a one-page OT inventory (device, location, firmware, owner, network connections) by 2026-10-31, reviewed every year and after every change.

The EAP covers project emergencies and local gate operation, including at night. There is no OT recovery procedure. The BIA (P05) was approved on 2026-08-31. Planned: a short OT recovery procedure (who rebuilds what, from which copy, in what order) by 2026-12-31.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a system restoration and recovery, voluntary); 18 CFR 12.22

implementation_statement: The annual EAP readiness test (last 2026-02-17) and the annual gate test on standby power exercise local operation. The HMI and PLC restore has never been tested. Planned: first restore test with the integrator on the replacement HMI PC by 2027-03-31.
evidence: EAP readiness test record; gate test statement
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a: annual test of the restoration plan, voluntary); 18 CFR 12.25(b)

implementation_statement: The MSP backs up the suite nightly (30 days of versions). The company holds no copy of the gate and unit PLC logic or the HMI project; the integrator's copy is from 2023-05-18; governor and exciter settings were never copied. Planned: copies on 2 encrypted USB drives (one in the office safe) after every change and at least quarterly, by 2026-10-31.
evidence: Cloud backup job report (MSP); integrator file list
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a system restoration and recovery, voluntary)

implementation_statement: Recovery depends on the integrator's availability and copies. Planned with CP-2: rebuild steps for the HMI PC and PLC reload, with checks that gate positions match before returning to automatic control.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a system restoration and recovery, voluntary)

implementation_statement: Suite users are uniquely identified. HMI and remote desktop users are not: commands are recorded under the shared account, so nobody can tell who moved a gate.
evidence: Suite user export; HMI event journal sample

implementation_statement: MFA is enforced for all suite accounts, including administrators. There is no MFA on the remote desktop tool, the integrator VPN, the firewall administrator login, or the HMI PC. Planned: MFA on the single remote access path by 2026-11-30.

The shared remote desktop password was changed on 2026-08-12 for the first time since February 2023. P07 found manufacturer default passwords on the camera NVR and the cellular gateway and the HMI password written inside a control desk drawer. Planned: change defaults by 2026-09-15; password rules in POL-02 B.9.

provider_if_inherited: MSP; controls integrator; cyber insurer panel vendors
implementation_statement: The P08 runbook (approved 2026-08-31) puts gates and units in local control first, then cuts remote paths, and brings in the integrator and the insurer's panel firm. Staff are practiced in local operation from EAP drills, but the cyber steps have never been exercised.
evidence: P08 runbook; EAP readiness test record; insurance policy
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a intrusion detection and response, voluntary); C-DAMS-R02

implementation_statement: 18 CFR 12.10 reporting works for physical conditions (2024 hoist motor failure; 2025 rescue). Staff did not know that cyber security incidents are reportable conditions (12.3(b)(4)(xi)). POL-03 now sets the rule; training is due 2026-10-31.
The P08 runbook for unauthorized access to spillway and turbine controls serves as the incident response plan for this tier, with the contact sheet and the notification matrix.

The integrator connects through its always-on cellular VPN or the remote desktop tool whenever it chooses. Its work orders list the work done (used for billing), but sessions are not approved in advance, use no MFA, and are not watched. Interim from 2026-09-15: the router stays off unless a staff member starts and watches the session.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a: remote and third-party connections, voluntary)

implementation_statement: The integrator and the Controls and Electrical Technician move files to the HMI PC with ordinary USB drives. Planned: one company USB drive for OT, scanned on an office PC before use (POL-04 4.7).

Fence and locked gates at the powerhouse and substation; the hoist house and control room are locked when unattended. Keys are not inventoried: P07 found a hoist house key never returned by the former operator-mechanic, and the lock was not changed.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.2; Form 1 Q4, Q6; Table 9.3a general: physical security, voluntary)

implementation_statement: Four cameras record about 14 days of video to the NVR and can be viewed on staff phones. Nobody reviews recordings unless something happens; the NVR administrator account had its default password (P07).

A portable diesel generator with a manual transfer switch powers the gate hoists; it is load-tested every year with a verified statement. A UPS keeps the HMI PC, PLCs, and data logger running about 2 hours.
This SSP, approved 2026-08-31. It is written to serve as the cyber section of the site security plan the company will write voluntarily (Rev. 3A 3.3.3).
Workforce rules are in POL-02 Part C (approved 2026-08-31). Signed acknowledgments are not yet collected.

baseline: Not in High baseline (selected by tailoring)
implementation_statement: On 2026-08-31 the Owner designated in writing the Office and Compliance Administrator as security program coordinator and the Plant Superintendent as OT security lead; the Owner remains FERC primary security contact. Selected by tailoring because Rev. 3A 3.2 asks every licensee to name a security contact.
No termination checklist. Planned by 2026-09-30: suite and payroll access, shared OT password change, keys, gate codes, and phone app access on the last day.
Risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01), the first the company has done. POL-02 A.2 requires a yearly update each July.

The MSP checks office endpoints for missing patches. Nothing covers OT. Planned: the integrator compares OT component versions against manufacturer advisories every quarter from 2026-12; no active scanning of PLCs or governors.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3b vulnerability assessment, enhanced; adopted in part)

implementation_statement: Contracts with the MSP, the integrator, and the monitoring vendor have no security or incident notice terms. The monitoring vendor's SOC 2 Type 2 report was reviewed for the first time on 2026-08-20 (P09). Planned: security terms at each renewal; annual SOC 2 review.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a coordination: outsourcers and third-party contractors, voluntary)

implementation_statement: The HMI PC operating system has been out of vendor support since October 2025. Replacement with a supported operating system and current HMI software is funded (P01) and due 2027-03-31. Interim compensating steps: no web browsing on the HMI PC and no office access to it after the firewall rebuild (2026-10-31).
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a system lifecycle: mitigate deficiencies, voluntary)

implementation_statement: An industrial firewall separates the office and control networks, but one rule lets any office device reach the HMI PC by remote desktop and file sharing. The integrator's cellular router bypasses the firewall. The monitoring gateway sends data outbound only. Planned: rebuild the rules so no office device reaches the control network, by 2026-10-31.
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control and functional segregation, voluntary)

provider_if_inherited: Remote monitoring service vendor; remote desktop tool vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: The data gateway sends readings to the monitoring service over TLS, one way. Remote desktop sessions are encrypted by the tool. Suite traffic uses TLS.

evidence: MSP patch report (July 2026); HMI PC update history

evidence: MSP antivirus console export; HMI PC antivirus status

implementation_statement: Only process alarms are monitored; there is no security monitoring. Planned: a phone alert for every remote session start from the new remote access path, and the weekly review in AU-6, by 2026-11-30.
